title: A signed Fourier average bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0\le\delta\le1$, let $f$ be any real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $S$ be a subset of its coordinates. For a random subset $K$ formed by including each coordinate independently with probability $1-\delta$, the negative of the average of $(-1)^{|S\cap K|}\widehat f(S\cap K)$ is at most the average of $|\widehat f(S\cap K)|$, where $\widehat f$ denotes the uniform Fourier coefficient.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
